items.title: What the Pass Found
items.why:
Every screen was checked at seven sizes, in dark mode and with bigger text: 352 screen states. Nothing scrolls sideways, nothing runs off the screen, every button shows a focus ring for keyboards, and there were no errors.

Two plain bugs are already fixed (not published yet):
• History calendar: on phones up to 393 px wide, the Saturday column ran past the edge of the card. The days now shrink to fit.
• Check-in 1–5 scales: on small phones they broke into 4 buttons plus a lone wide "5" underneath. They now stay on one row.

Three design questions follow. Each shows the app now and with the fix tried in the browser.

items.title: Commas in Big Numbers
items.why: Most of the app writes 2,300 and 6,136, but a few spots write 1595: the food days in History, "Average calories" in the weekly recap, and the Gymnastics training load. The fix adds the comma everywhere.

options.label: Fix it
options.desc: 1,595 cal, the same as the rest of the app.

items.title: Future Days in the Calendar
items.why: Days that haven't happened yet are so faint (2.2 to 1) that they are hard to read, below the 4.5 to 1 needed for small text. The fix makes them darker but still clearly lighter than past days (4.8 to 1).

items.title: Rows Cut Off With Bigger Text
items.why: When the phone's text size is turned up, the one-line rows on Home (Coach, Fuel, Circuit) cut off with "…", for example "Make Goku yours · about 3 …". The fix lets a row wrap to a second line only when it doesn't fit. At normal text size nothing changes.
